<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head><script id="rjx-v29-bootstrap">
/* V29 startup safety + answer-order engine. Loaded before every feature pack. */
function rjxV29Hash(value){var h=2166136261>>>0,s=String(value||'');for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){h^=s.charCodeAt(i);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return h>>>0}
window.rjxShuffledChoice=function(options,correct,seed){
  var src=Array.isArray(options)?options.slice():[];var n=src.length;if(!n)return {options:src,correct:0};
  var ci=Number(correct);if(!Number.isInteger(ci)||ci<0||ci>=n)ci=0;var right=src[ci];
  var wrong=src.map(function(x,i){return {x:x,i:i,k:rjxV29Hash(String(seed)+'|'+i+'|'+x)}}).filter(function(z){return z.i!==ci}).sort(function(a,b){return a.k-b.k}).map(function(z){return z.x});
  var target=rjxV29Hash(String(seed)+'|correct-position')%n;var result=[];var wi=0;for(var j=0;j<n;j++)result.push(j===target?right:wrong[wi++]);
  return {options:result,correct:target};
};
window.rjxShuffleTupleInPlace=function(q,seed){if(!Array.isArray(q)||q._rjxV29||!Array.isArray(q[1])||!Number.isInteger(q[2])||q[2]<0||q[2]>=q[1].length)return q;var sh=window.rjxShuffledChoice(q[1],q[2],seed||q[0]);q[1]=sh.options;q[2]=sh.correct;q._rjxV29=true;return q};
window.rjxShuffleObjInPlace=function(o,seed){if(!o||typeof o!=='object'||o._rjxV29)return o;var opts=null,key=null;if(Array.isArray(o.options)){opts='options';key=Number.isInteger(o.correct)?'correct':(Number.isInteger(o.answer)?'answer':null)}else if(Array.isArray(o.opts)){opts='opts';key=Number.isInteger(o.correct)?'correct':(Number.isInteger(o.ans)?'ans':null)}if(opts&&key&&o[key]>=0&&o[key]<o[opts].length){var sh=window.rjxShuffledChoice(o[opts],o[key],seed||o.question||o.q||o.title);o[opts]=sh.options;o[key]=sh.correct;o._rjxV29=true}return o};
window.rjxDeepShuffleQuizData=function(root,label){var seen=new WeakSet(),count=0;function walk(v,path){if(!v||typeof v!=='object'||seen.has(v))return;seen.add(v);if(Array.isArray(v)&&Array.isArray(v[1])&&Number.isInteger(v[2])&&v[2]>=0&&v[2]<v[1].length){window.rjxShuffleTupleInPlace(v,(label||'quiz')+'|'+path+'|'+(v[0]||''));count++;return}if(!Array.isArray(v)){var before=v._rjxV29;window.rjxShuffleObjInPlace(v,(label||'quiz')+'|'+path);if(!before&&v._rjxV29)count++}Object.keys(v).forEach(function(k){if(k!=='_rjxV29')walk(v[k],path+'.'+k)})}walk(root,'root');return count};
/* Safe fallbacks prevent one later feature pack from stopping the entire site. */
var speakBritish=window.speakBritish=window.speakBritish||function(text,voiceName,rate){if(!('speechSynthesis' in window)||!text)return;try{speechSynthesis.cancel();var u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(String(text));u.lang='en-GB';u.rate=rate||.92;var vs=speechSynthesis.getVoices(),v=vs.find(function(x){return /^en-GB$/i.test(x.lang)})||vs.find(function(x){return /^en/i.test(x.lang)});if(v)u.voice=v;speechSynthesis.speak(u)}catch(e){}};
var britishVoices=window.britishVoices=window.britishVoices||function(){try{return ('speechSynthesis' in window)?speechSynthesis.getVoices().filter(function(v){return /^en/i.test(v.lang)}):[]}catch(e){return []}};
var kidsSpeech=window.kidsSpeech=window.kidsSpeech||function(text){speakBritish(text,null,.84)};
var buildActivity=window.buildActivity=window.buildActivity||function(){return '<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Interactive activity</h4><p>This activity is initialising. Re-open the lesson if it does not appear immediately.</p></div>'};
var wireActivity=window.wireActivity=window.wireActivity||function(){};
var renderDictionary=window.renderDictionary=window.renderDictionary||function(){var root=document.getElementById('rjxDictionaryBody');if(root)root.innerHTML='<div class="rjx-card"><h2>English Dictionary</h2><p>The dictionary is initialising…</p></div>'};
</script>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>RJ Language Academy</title>
<meta name="description" content="RJ Language Academy — British English lessons, practice, IELTS, TOEIC and member learning resources.">
<style>
:root {
  --navy:#07172f;
  --blue:#0b63f6;
  --blue-dark:#094fc2;
  --ink:#14213d;
  --muted:#5f6d82;
  --line:#e7ebf2;
  --soft:#f6f8fb;
  --white:#ffffff;
  --orange:#b56b00;
  --red:#ca2d32;
  --green:#138451;
  --shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(17,37,67,.09);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;
  color:var(--ink);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,#f7f9fc 100%);
  font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;
}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit}

.site-header{
  height:82px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f5;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  position:sticky;
  top:0;
  z-index:50;
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
}
.nav-wrap{
  width:min(1320px,92vw);
  margin:auto;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:28px;
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-width:270px}
.brand-mark{
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:52px;
  line-height:.8;
  letter-spacing:-7px;
  color:#0d2c67;
}
.brand-copy strong{
  display:block;
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:18px;
  letter-spacing:2px;
  font-weight:500;
}
.brand-copy span{
  display:block;
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:4px;
  color:#7f8999;
  margin-top:5px;
}
.main-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:29px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
.main-nav a{position:relative;padding:30px 0 27px}
.main-nav a.active::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0;right:0;bottom:18px;
  height:2px;background:var(--blue);
}
.chev{font-size:10px;margin-left:4px}
.book-btn{
  padding:15px 27px;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:var(--blue);
  color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(11,99,246,.18);
  font-weight:700;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.book-btn:hover{background:var(--blue-dark)}

.mobile-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:0;font-size:25px;color:var(--navy)}

.hero{
  min-height:575px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:#fff;
}
.hero::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0 0 0 43%;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.72) 13%,rgba(255,255,255,.10) 39%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 56%),
    url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center right/cover no-repeat;
}
.hero::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:auto 0 0 0;
  height:120px;
  background:linear-gradient(0deg,#f8fafc 0%,rgba(248,250,252,0) 100%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-inner{
  width:min(1320px,92vw);
  min-height:575px;
  margin:auto;
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
}
.hero-copy{width:min(620px,50%);padding:58px 0 95px}
.kicker{
  color:var(--blue);
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:3.7px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.kicker span{color:#7795cf;font-weight:500}
.hero h1{
  margin:0;
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:64px;
  line-height:1.03;
  letter-spacing:-2px;
  color:#09172f;
  font-weight:700;
}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue)}
.hero p{
  max-width:590px;
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:21px;
  line-height:1.48;
  color:#46546a;
  margin:25px 0 27px;
}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cta{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:22px;
  padding:16px 25px;
  border-radius:9px;
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-weight:700;
  font-size:17px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--blue);
  transition:.18s ease;
}
.cta.primary{background:var(--blue);color:white}
.cta.secondary{background:white;color:#12356f}
.cta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}

.home-grid{
  width:min(1360px,94vw);
  margin:-64px auto 0;
  position:relative;
  z-index:5;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:16px;
}
.home-card{
  min-height:305px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);
  border:1px solid #edf0f4;
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:31px 34px 25px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  transition:.18s ease;
}
.home-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(17,37,67,.13)}
.card-tag{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:14px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:4px;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:800;
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.card-tag::after{content:"";width:42px;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.8}
.home-card h2{
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:31px;
  line-height:1.06;
  margin:0 0 15px;
  color:#0c1730;
}
.home-card p{
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.45;
  color:#58657a;
  margin:0 0 22px;
}
.card-link{
  margin-top:auto;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top:18px;
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-weight:700;
  font-size:17px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:15px;
}
.card-link span{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:24px;line-height:1}
.lesson .card-tag,.lesson .card-link{color:var(--blue)}
.practice .card-tag,.practice .card-link{color:var(--orange)}
.exams .card-tag,.exams .card-link{color:var(--red)}
.members .card-tag,.members .card-link{color:var(--green)}

.level-wrap{
  width:min(1360px,94vw);
  margin:25px auto 46px;
  background:white;
  border:1px solid #e8ecf2;
  box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(16,39,74,.05);
  border-radius:32px;
  min-height:105px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:310px 1fr;
  align-items:center;
  padding:12px 30px 12px 42px;
}
.level-title{
  border-right:1px solid #e2e6ed;
  padding-right:35px;
}
.level-title strong{
  display:block;
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-size:27px;
  color:#0b1730;
}
.level-title span{
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  color:#708096;
  font-size:16px;
}
.levels{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);
  gap:16px;
  text-align:center;
}
.level a{display:block}
.bubble{
  width:54px;height:54px;
  border-radius:50%;
  margin:0 auto 7px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  font-weight:700;font-size:18px;
  transition:.18s ease;
}
.level a:hover .bubble{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.04)}
.level small{font-size:12px;color:#50617a}
.a1{background:#ddebfb} .a2{background:#dff4e9} .b1{background:#fff0d4}
.b2{background:#ffe1e5} .c1{background:#e9e0ff} .c2{background:#e9edf2}

.micro-footer{
  border-top:1px solid #e9edf3;
  padding:24px 0 30px;
  color:#7a8798;
  font-size:12px;
  text-align:center;
}
.micro-footer strong{color:#243551}

@media (max-width:1050px){
  .main-nav{gap:18px;font-size:13px}
  .brand{min-width:220px}
  .brand-copy strong{font-size:15px}
  .hero h1{font-size:55px}
  .home-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);margin-top:-35px}
  .level-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:24px}
  .level-title{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e6ed;padding:0 0 18px;margin-bottom:18px;text-align:center}
}
@media (max-width:800px){
  .site-header{height:72px}
  .brand{min-width:auto}
  .brand-mark{font-size:44px}
  .brand-copy strong{font-size:14px}
  .brand-copy span{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2.5px}
  .main-nav,.book-btn{display:none}
  .mobile-toggle{display:block}
  .main-nav.open{
    display:flex;
    position:absolute;
    top:72px;
    left:0;right:0;
    background:white;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:stretch;
    padding:10px 24px 22px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 30px rgba(20,35,60,.09);
  }
  .main-nav.open a{padding:13px 0}
  .main-nav a.active::after{bottom:5px;width:34px;right:auto}
  .hero{min-height:620px}
  .hero::before{
    inset:0;
    opacity:.42;
    background:
      linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.96) 45%,rgba(255,255,255,.25) 100%),
      url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center right/cover no-repeat;
  }
  .hero-inner{min-height:620px}
  .hero-copy{width:100%;padding:45px 0 110px}
  .hero h1{font-size:49px;max-width:600px}
  .hero p{font-size:19px;max-width:520px}
  .home-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-top:-55px}
  .home-card{min-height:auto}
  .levels{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);row-gap:20px}
}
@media (max-width:520px){
  .nav-wrap{width:91vw}
  .brand-copy strong{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
  .brand-copy span{display:none}
  .hero h1{font-size:41px;letter-spacing:-1px}
  .kicker{letter-spacing:2.4px;font-size:10px}
  .hero p{font-size:17px}
  .cta{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}
  .home-grid{width:91vw}
  .home-card{padding:27px}
  .level-wrap{width:91vw;border-radius:23px}
  .levels{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}

/* V8 certificate and AI/contact responsive refinements */
@media(max-width:900px){.rjx-cert-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.rjx-cert-thumb{height:min(72vh,620px)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.rjx-cert-thumb{height:440px;padding:8px}.rjx-chat-compose{grid-template-columns:1fr}.rjx-ai-tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}}
.rjx-ai-tools{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}.rjx-ai-status{font-size:13px;color:#64748b;margin-top:8px}.rjx-ai-status strong{color:#111827}.rjx-contact-help{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px}@media(max-width:760px){.rjx-contact-help{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<style>
#home,#lessons,#practice,#exams,#members,#levels{scroll-margin-top:96px}
</style>


<style>
/* ===== RJ internal pages: added without changing the original homepage ===== */
#rjInternalPages{display:none}
.rj-page{display:none;background:#f8fafc;min-height:calc(100vh - 82px)}
.rj-page.active{display:block}
.rj-shell{width:min(1100px,92vw);margin:0 auto;padding:28px 0 60px}
.rj-hero{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f4}
.rj-hero-inner{width:min(1100px,92vw);margin:auto;padding:54px 0 39px}
.rj-eyebrow{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:3.4px;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:13px}
.rj-hero h1{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:49px;line-height:1.06;margin:0;color:#0b1730;letter-spacing:-1.2px}
.rj-hero h1 span{color:#0b63f6}
.rj-hero p{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18px;line-height:1.58;color:#5b687b;max-width:720px;margin:16px 0 0}
.rj-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:17px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(17,37,67,.035)}
.rj-panel-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:18px;padding:2px 4px 14px}
.rj-panel-top strong{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:22px;color:#0b1730}
.rj-panel-top span{font-size:12px;color:#8190a2}
.rj-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:8px}
.rj-tabs.practice{grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr)}
.rj-tab{border:1px solid #dfe5ed;background:#fff;color:#4d5d74;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.rj-tab.active{background:#0b63f6;border-color:#0b63f6;color:#fff}
.rj-section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;margin:24px 3px 12px}
.rj-section-head h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:32px;margin:0;color:#0b1730}
.rj-section-head p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#738095;font-size:14px}
.rj-list{display:grid;gap:10px}
.rj-row{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:14px;padding:18px 21px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:22px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.16s}
.rj-row:hover{border-color:#bdd2f6;box-shadow:0 9px 24px rgba(17,37,67,.06);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.rj-meta{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:7px}
.rj-badge{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.3px;font-weight:800;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;background:#f1f5fa;color:#5b6c84}
.rj-badge.blue{background:#edf5ff;color:#0a5edc}
.rj-row h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:22px;margin:0 0 5px;color:#0c1730}
.rj-row p{margin:0;color:#6c788b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;max-width:760px}
.rj-open{color:#0b63f6;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.rj-note{margin-top:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:14px;padding:17px 20px;color:#718096;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.rj-note strong{color:#243650}

/* Free sampler */
.rj-free-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 260px;gap:20px;align-items:start}
.rj-progress{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:17px;padding:19px}
.rj-progress-track{height:8px;background:#edf1f6;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px}
.rj-progress-bar{height:100%;background:#0b63f6;width:0;transition:.25s}
.rj-free-side{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:17px;padding:20px}
.rj-free-side strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:24px;color:#0b1730}
.rj-free-side p{font-size:13px;color:#728096;line-height:1.5}
.rj-steps{display:grid;gap:7px;margin-top:12px}
.rj-step{padding:9px;border:1px solid #e3e7ed;border-radius:9px;font-size:11px;color:#6f7d91}
.rj-step.active{background:#eef5ff;color:#0b5bd8;border-color:#b8cff5}
.rj-step.done{background:#f0faf4;color:#187446;border-color:#c8e5d5}
.rj-free-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(17,37,67,.08);overflow:hidden}
.rj-free-head{padding:21px 24px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5eaf1}
.rj-free-head h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:28px;margin:0;color:#0b1730}
.rj-free-body{padding:23px 24px 26px}
.rj-free-foot{padding:15px 24px 20px;border-top:1px solid #e5eaf1;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.rj-free-foot button{border-radius:9px;padding:11px 15px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800}
.rj-finish{display:none;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:18px;padding:36px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(17,37,67,.08)}
.rj-finish.show{display:block}
.rj-finish h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:34px;color:#0b1730;margin:0 0 10px}
.rj-finish p{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18px;color:#657287;max-width:620px;margin:0 auto 20px;line-height:1.55}
.rj-btn-primary{border:1px solid #0b63f6;background:#0b63f6;color:#fff}
.rj-btn-secondary{border:1px solid #dce3ec;background:#fff;color:#35455e}

/* Modal shared by lessons and practice */
.rj-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(8,19,39,.58);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;z-index:200}
.rj-modal.open{display:flex}
.rj-modal-card{width:min(740px,96vw);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.rj-modal-head{padding:23px 25px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5eaf1;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px}
.rj-modal-meta{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:7px}
.rj-modal-head h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:30px;margin:0;color:#0b1730}
.rj-close{border:0;background:#f2f5f8;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;font-size:23px;cursor:pointer}
.rj-modal-body{padding:23px 25px 27px}
.rj-modal-body p{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:17px;line-height:1.62;color:#526176}
.rj-label{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#8390a2;margin:22px 0 8px}
.rj-examples{background:#f7f9fc;border-left:3px solid #0b63f6;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;color:#46566d;line-height:1.6}
.rj-task{background:#fff8e9;border:1px solid #f6e4bb;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;color:#5f5133;line-height:1.55}
.rj-question{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#162640;margin-bottom:12px}
.rj-options{display:grid;gap:9px}
.rj-option{width:100%;text-align:left;border:1px solid #dfe5ed;background:#fff;color:#243650;-webkit-text-fill-color:#243650;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;font-weight:650;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;color-scheme:light}
.rj-option.correct{background:#eef9f2;border-color:#a7d9ba;color:#176c3a;-webkit-text-fill-color:#176c3a}
.rj-option.wrong{background:#fff0f0;border-color:#e8b4b7;color:#a22626;-webkit-text-fill-color:#a22626}
.rj-feedback{margin-top:12px;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 13px;background:#f6f8fb;color:#58667b;font-size:13px;display:none}
.rj-feedback.show{display:block}
.rj-modal-foot{border-top:1px solid #e5eaf1;padding:16px 25px 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.rj-modal-foot button{border-radius:9px;padding:11px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800}
.rj-speak{border:1px solid #dce4ee;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:13px;padding:19px}
.rj-speak-prompt{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:21px;line-height:1.5;color:#172640;margin:0 0 15px}
.rj-tips{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.rj-tip{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0e6ee;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px;color:#65738a}
.rj-timer-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;border-top:1px solid #e1e6ed;padding-top:16px}
.rj-timer{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:30px;color:#0b63f6}
.rj-timer-btn{border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#0b63f6;color:#fff;padding:11px 14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}

@media(max-width:980px){
 .rj-tabs.practice{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:800px){
 .rj-page{min-height:calc(100vh - 72px)}
 .rj-hero h1{font-size:42px}
 .rj-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
 .rj-tabs.practice{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
 .rj-free-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-free-side{order:-1}
}
@media(max-width:520px){
 .rj-shell,.rj-hero-inner{width:91vw}
 .rj-hero h1{font-size:37px}
 .rj-tabs,.rj-tabs.practice{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
 .rj-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-modal{padding:10px}
}
</style>


<style id="rj-members-first-page-css">
/* ===== Members Academy first page ===== */
.rj-members-wrap{width:min(1120px,92vw);margin:0 auto;padding:30px 0 64px}
.rj-members-intro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:22px;margin-bottom:26px}
.rj-member-welcome,.rj-member-status{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:18px;padding:26px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(17,37,67,.045)
}
.rj-member-welcome h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:34px;line-height:1.08;margin:0 0 10px;color:#0b1730}
.rj-member-welcome p{margin:0;color:#66758a;line-height:1.6;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:17px}
.rj-member-status{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.rj-member-status small{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:800;color:#8290a2}
.rj-member-status strong{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:24px;color:#0b1730;margin:7px 0}
.rj-member-status p{margin:0;color:#6b788b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}

.rj-members-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;margin:30px 2px 14px}
.rj-members-heading h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:32px;margin:0;color:#0b1730}
.rj-members-heading p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#748196;font-size:14px;max-width:680px}

.rj-plan-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
.rj-plan{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e7ee;border-radius:18px;padding:25px;position:relative;
  box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(17,37,67,.045);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:390px
}
.rj-plan.featured{border:2px solid #0b63f6;box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(11,99,246,.12)}
.rj-plan-topline{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:800;color:#7d8b9d}
.rj-plan.featured .rj-plan-topline{color:#0b63f6}
.rj-popular{
 position:absolute;right:18px;top:17px;background:#edf5ff;color:#0a5edc;border-radius:999px;
 padding:6px 9px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase
}
.rj-plan h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:27px;margin:9px 0 3px;color:#0b1730}
.rj-price{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:39px;color:#0b1730;margin:3px 0 12px}
.rj-price small{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:#748196;font-weight:700}
.rj-plan-copy{font-size:13px;color:#66758a;line-height:1.5;min-height:58px}
.rj-plan-list{list-style:none;margin:14px 0 20px;padding:0;display:grid;gap:9px;flex:1}
.rj-plan-list li{position:relative;padding-left:18px;color:#46566d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4}
.rj-plan-list li:before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:900}
.rj-plan button{width:100%;border-radius:9px;padding:12px 14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.rj-plan .light{border:1px solid #dbe3ed;background:#fff;color:#263a58}
.rj-plan .dark{border:1px solid #0b1730;background:#0b1730;color:#fff}
.rj-plan .blue{border:1px solid #0b63f6;background:#0b63f6;color:#fff}

.rj-member-featured{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}
.rj-member-big{
 background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:16px;padding:22px;cursor:pointer;
 display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:18px;align-items:center;transition:.16s
}
.rj-member-big:hover{border-color:#b8cef3;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(17,37,67,.06);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.rj-member-big .type{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:900}
.rj-member-big h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:25px;color:#0b1730;margin:8px 0 6px}
.rj-member-big p{margin:0;color:#6d7a8d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.rj-member-big .go{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}

.rj-member-group{margin-top:22px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:18px;padding:22px}
.rj-member-group-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:18px;margin-bottom:13px}
.rj-member-group-head h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:24px;color:#0b1730;margin:0}
.rj-member-group-head span{font-size:11px;color:#8491a2}
.rj-member-tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.rj-member-tool{
 border:1px solid #e2e7ee;background:#fbfcfe;border-radius:12px;padding:15px 16px;cursor:pointer;
 text-align:left;transition:.14s;min-height:108px
}
.rj-member-tool:hover{background:#fff;border-color:#b8cef3;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(17,37,67,.05)}
.rj-member-tool .tool-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.rj-member-tool .code{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#0b63f6;text-transform:uppercase}
.rj-tier{
 font-size:8px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;
 padding:4px 7px;background:#eef2f7;color:#607087
}
.rj-tier.vault{background:#edf5ff;color:#0b5bd8}
.rj-tier.platinum{background:#fff4df;color:#8b6110}
.rj-member-tool strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18px;color:#15243d;margin:8px 0 5px}
.rj-member-tool p{margin:0;color:#748196;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}
.rj-built{color:#177447!important;background:#eff9f3!important}

.rj-members-note{
 margin-top:20px;background:#f3f7fd;border:1px solid #dce8f7;border-radius:14px;padding:17px 19px;
 color:#607087;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5
}
.rj-members-note strong{color:#213651}

.rj-member-detail{display:grid;gap:12px}
.rj-member-detail-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:9px;margin-top:4px}
.rj-member-detail-item{border:1px solid #e2e7ee;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;color:#506078;font-size:13px}
.rj-build-state{border-left:3px solid #0b63f6;background:#f3f7fd;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;color:#52657e;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}

@media(max-width:940px){
 .rj-plan-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-plan{min-height:auto}
 .rj-members-intro{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-member-tools{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
 .rj-member-featured,.rj-member-tools{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-member-big{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-member-detail-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-members-heading{display:block}
}
</style>


<style id="rj-silver-area-css">
/* ===== RJ Silver member area ===== */
.rj-silver-shell{width:min(1120px,92vw);margin:0 auto;padding:28px 0 64px}
.rj-silver-top{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 18px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(17,37,67,.035);margin-bottom:18px
}
.rj-silver-top strong{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:20px;color:#0b1730}
.rj-silver-top span{font-size:12px;color:#7b899c}
.rj-silver-back{border:1px solid #dbe3ed;background:#fff;color:#2d405f;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.rj-silver-page{display:none}
.rj-silver-page.active{display:block}
.rj-silver-intro{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:18px;padding:25px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(17,37,67,.045);margin-bottom:18px
}
.rj-silver-intro small{display:block;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;color:#748196;margin-bottom:8px}
.rj-silver-intro h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:33px;margin:0 0 8px;color:#0b1730}
.rj-silver-intro p{margin:0;color:#67758a;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:17px;line-height:1.55}
.rj-silver-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:13px}
.rj-silver-card{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4e9ef;border-radius:15px;padding:20px;
  text-align:left;transition:.15s
}
button.rj-silver-card{cursor:pointer}
button.rj-silver-card:hover{border-color:#b9cff2;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(17,37,67,.055);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.rj-silver-card .ey{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:900}
.rj-silver-card h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:23px;margin:8px 0 7px;color:#13223a}
.rj-silver-card p{margin:0;color:#6d7a8d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.rj-silver-card ul{margin:12px 0 0;padding-left:18px;color:#526078;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
.rj-silver-card .go{display:block;color:#0b63f6;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:700;margin-top:13px}
.rj-silver-lesson-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:13px}
.rj-silver-level{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4e9ef;border-radius:15px;padding:20px;
  box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(17,37,67,.035)
}
.rj-silver-level-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:11px}
.rj-silver-level-head strong{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:23px;color:#0b1730}
.rj-silver-level-head span{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.3px;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:900}
.rj-silver-lessons{display:grid;gap:7px}
.rj-silver-lesson{
  border:1px solid #edf0f4;background:#f9fbfd;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 11px;
  color:#4d5d74;font-size:12px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start
}
.rj-silver-num{font-weight:900;color:#0b63f6;min-width:18px}
.rj-silver-level button{margin-top:13px;border:1px solid #0b63f6;background:#fff;color:#0b63f6;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.rj-silver-practice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:11px}
.rj-silver-practice-card{
  border:1px solid #e3e8ef;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:17px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left
}
.rj-silver-practice-card:hover{border-color:#b8cef3;background:#fbfdff}
.rj-silver-practice-card strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:19px;color:#13223a;margin:6px 0}
.rj-silver-practice-card span{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.4px;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:900}
.rj-silver-practice-card p{margin:0;color:#748196;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}
.rj-silver-resource-list{display:grid;gap:10px}
.rj-silver-resource{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4e9ef;border-radius:13px;padding:16px 18px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:16px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer
}
.rj-silver-resource:hover{border-color:#b9cff2}
.rj-silver-resource strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:19px;color:#14243d}
.rj-silver-resource small{display:block;color:#7a8799;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px}
.rj-silver-resource .tag{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.2px;font-weight:900;color:#177447;background:#eff9f3;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 8px}
.rj-silver-nav{
  margin-top:22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4e9ef;border-radius:14px;padding:13px 15px
}
.rj-silver-nav button{border:1px solid #dce3ec;background:#fff;color:#35455e;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.rj-silver-nav button.next{justify-self:end;background:#0b63f6;color:#fff;border-color:#0b63f6}
.rj-silver-nav button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}
.rj-silver-nav span{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#7f8b9c;font-weight:800}
.rj-silver-summary{
  margin-top:15px;background:#f3f7fd;border:1px solid #dce8f7;border-radius:13px;padding:15px 17px;
  color:#586b84;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5
}
.rj-silver-summary strong{color:#1d3554}
.rj-silver-section-title{margin:25px 2px 12px}
.rj-silver-section-title h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:27px;margin:0;color:#0b1730}
.rj-silver-section-title p{margin:5px 0 0;color:#748196;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:850px){
 .rj-silver-grid,.rj-silver-lesson-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-silver-practice-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
 .rj-silver-practice-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .rj-silver-top{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
 .rj-silver-nav{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .rj-silver-nav span{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:1}
}
</style>


<style id="rj-complete-build-css">
.rjx-page{display:none;background:#f7f9fc;min-height:calc(100vh - 82px)}.rjx-page.active{display:block}
.rjx-wrap{width:min(1120px,92vw);margin:0 auto;padding:28px 0 64px}.rjx-hero{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e5eaf1}.rjx-hero-in{width:min(1120px,92vw);margin:auto;padding:48px 0 38px}.rjx-kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:900}.rjx-hero h1{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:46px;line-height:1.07;color:#0b1730;margin:11px 0 10px}.rjx-hero h1 span{color:#0b63f6}.rjx-hero p{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;color:#657287;max-width:760px;margin:0}
.rjx-toolbar,.rjx-card,.rjx-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(17,37,67,.04)}.rjx-toolbar{padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap}.rjx-breadcrumb{font-size:11px;color:#718096}.rjx-breadcrumb button{border:0;background:none;color:#0b63f6;cursor:pointer;padding:0;font:inherit;font-weight:800}.rjx-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.rjx-btn{border:1px solid #dbe2ec;background:#fff;color:#2d405f;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.rjx-btn.primary{background:#0b63f6;border-color:#0b63f6;color:#fff}.rjx-btn.dark{background:#0b1730;border-color:#0b1730;color:#fff}.rjx-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.rjx-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:end;margin:24px 2px 13px}.rjx-head h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:31px;color:#0b1730;margin:0}.rjx-head p{font-size:13px;color:#748196;margin:6px 0 0;max-width:720px}.rjx-grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:13px}.rjx-grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:13px}.rjx-grid4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}.rjx-card{padding:20px}.rjx-card.click{cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}.rjx-card.click:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#b9cff2;box-shadow:0 11px 28px rgba(17,37,67,.07)}.rjx-tag{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.6px;font-weight:900;color:#0b63f6}.rjx-card h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:22px;color:#14243d;margin:8px 0 6px}.rjx-card p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#6f7c8f;margin:0}.rjx-link{display:block;margin-top:12px;color:#0b63f6;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:700}.rjx-list{display:grid;gap:9px}.rjx-row{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:13px;padding:16px 18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:18px;align-items:center}.rjx-row.click{cursor:pointer}.rjx-row.click:hover{border-color:#b8cef3}.rjx-row strong{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18px;color:#14243d}.rjx-row small{display:block;color:#7a8799;margin-top:4px}.rjx-chip{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:900;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;background:#edf5ff;color:#0b5bd8;white-space:nowrap}.rjx-chip.gold{background:#fff6df;color:#956714}.rjx-chip.platinum{background:#f1edff;color:#5c43a9}.rjx-note{margin-top:16px;border:1px solid #dce8f7;background:#f3f7fd;border-radius:13px;padding:15px 17px;color:#596c84;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.rjx-note strong{color:#203957}
.rjx-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.rjx-tab{border:1px solid #dce3ec;background:#fff;color:#52627a;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}.rjx-tab.active{background:#0b63f6;color:#fff;border-color:#0b63f6}
.rjx-plan-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:15px}.rjx-plan{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e7ee;border-radius:18px;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:430px;position:relative}.rjx-plan.featured{border:2px solid #0b63f6;box-shadow:0 15px 36px rgba(11,99,246,.1)}.rjx-plan h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:27px;color:#0b1730;margin:8px 0}.rjx-price{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:38px;color:#0b1730}.rjx-price small{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:#78869a}.rjx-plan ul{padding-left:18px;color:#526078;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;flex:1}.rjx-plan .rjx-actions{margin-top:12px}.rjx-plan .rjx-actions .rjx-btn{flex:1}.rjx-pop{position:absolute;right:16px;top:14px;background:#edf5ff;color:#0b63f6;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.rjx-lesson{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden}.rjx-lesson-head{padding:23px 25px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #e7ebf1}.rjx-lesson-head h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#0b1730;font-size:32px;margin:7px 0}.rjx-lesson-body{padding:22px 25px}.rjx-lesson-body h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#172640;font-size:21px;margin:22px 0 8px}.rjx-lesson-body p{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;color:#536278}.rjx-examples{border-left:3px solid #0b63f6;background:#f7f9fc;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;color:#485870;line-height:1.65}.rjx-task{background:#fff8e9;border:1px solid #f3e3bd;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;color:#5b4c31}.rjx-q{margin-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #edf0f4;padding-top:14px}.rjx-q strong{display:block;color:#21334f;margin-bottom:8px}.rjx-options{display:grid;gap:7px}.rjx-option{border:1px solid #dfe5ed;background:#fff;color:#2c405f;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 12px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}.rjx-option.correct{background:#eef9f2;border-color:#a7d9ba;color:#176c3a}.rjx-option.wrong{background:#fff0f0;border-color:#e8b4b7;color:#a22626}.rjx-feedback{display:none;margin-top:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;background:#f5f7fa;color:#5b6a7e;font-size:12px}.rjx-feedback.show{display:block}.rjx-bottom-nav{margin-top:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:13px;padding:12px 14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center}.rjx-bottom-nav .next{justify-self:end}.rjx-bottom-nav span{font-size:11px;color:#8290a2;text-align:center;font-weight:800}
.rjx-practice-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:16px;padding:22px}.rjx-practice-box h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#0b1730;font-size:25px;margin:6px 0 12px}.rjx-timer{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:32px;color:#0b63f6;margin:12px 0}.rjx-progress-track{height:8px;background:#edf1f6;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}.rjx-progress-bar{height:100%;background:#0b63f6;width:0}.rjx-stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}.rjx-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:14px;padding:18px}.rjx-stat b{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:28px;color:#0b1730}.rjx-stat span{display:block;font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.3px;color:#7d8a9c;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:6px}.rjx-input,.rjx-select,.rjx-textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid #dbe2eb;background:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 12px;color:#21334f;font:inherit}.rjx-textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}.rjx-form{display:grid;gap:11px}.rjx-label{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#718096;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:5px}.rjx-chat{height:330px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:13px;padding:14px;display:grid;align-content:start;gap:9px}.rjx-bubble{max-width:82%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.rjx-bubble.bot{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;color:#46566c}.rjx-bubble.user{background:#0b63f6;color:#fff;justify-self:end}.rjx-chat-compose{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px;margin-top:9px}.rjx-lock{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:#956714;background:#fff6df;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px}.rjx-silver{border-top:4px solid #aab5c5}.rjx-gold{border-top:4px solid #d7a12b}.rjx-platinum{border-top:4px solid #5f48b5}
.rjx-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(7,18,37,.6);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;z-index:999}.rjx-modal.open{display:flex}.rjx-modal-card{width:min(720px,96vw);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}.rjx-modal-head{padding:22px 24px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5eaf1;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}.rjx-modal-head h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#0b1730;margin:4px 0 0}.rjx-modal-body{padding:20px 24px 24px}.rjx-close{border:0;background:#f1f4f7;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer}.rjx-checklist{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:12px}.rjx-check{border:1px solid #e1e6ed;background:#f9fbfd;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 11px;color:#526078;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:920px){.rjx-grid4,.rjx-stat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.rjx-grid3,.rjx-plan-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.rjx-plan{min-height:auto}}@media(max-width:700px){.rjx-grid2,.rjx-grid4{grid-template-columns:1fr}.rjx-bottom-nav{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.rjx-bottom-nav span{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:1}.rjx-hero h1{font-size:38px}.rjx-checklist{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>


<style id="rjx-v2-css">
/* Lessons dropdown: same top-level navigation, no extra hero-bar buttons */
.nav-drop{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center}
.nav-drop-menu{
  display:none;position:absolute;top:64px;left:-18px;min-width:230px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eaf1;border-radius:12px;padding:8px;
  box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(20,35,60,.12);z-index:200
}
.nav-drop:hover .nav-drop-menu,.nav-drop:focus-within .nav-drop-menu{display:grid}
.nav-drop-menu button{
  border:0;background:#fff;color:#253955;text-align:left;padding:11px 12px;
  border-radius:8px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer
}
.nav-drop-menu button:hover{background:#f3f7fd;color:#0b63f6}

/* Member dashboard lesson library */
.rjx-member-lessons{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:18px;padding:20px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(17,37,67,.04);margin:16px 0 24px
}
.rjx-member-levels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:11px;margin-top:13px}
.rjx-member-level{
  border:1px solid #e3e8ef;background:#fbfcfe;border-radius:13px;padding:15px;
  text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s
}
.rjx-member-level:hover{background:#fff;border-color:#b9cff2;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(17,37,67,.055);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.rjx-member-level .level-code{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:900}
.rjx-member-level strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#14243d;font-size:20px;margin:6px 0}
.rjx-member-level p{font-size:12px;color:#748196;line-height:1.45;margin:0}
.rjx-member-level small{display:block;margin-top:8px;color:#526078;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}
.rjx-member-level .open-level{display:block;margin-top:10px;color:#0b63f6;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}

/* About Me */
.rjx-about-profile{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,.72fr) 1.28fr;gap:24px;align-items:stretch}
.rjx-about-photo{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:18px;padding:12px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(17,37,67,.055)
}
.rjx-about-photo img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:510px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;border-radius:13px}
.rjx-about-copy{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:18px;padding:25px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(17,37,67,.04)
}
.rjx-about-copy h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:33px;color:#0b1730;margin:8px 0 10px}
.rjx-about-copy p{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;color:#56657a}
.rjx-help-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:11px}
.rjx-help-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:14px;padding:17px}
.rjx-help-card strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#14243d;font-size:18px;margin-bottom:5px}
.rjx-help-card span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:#718096}
/* V8 certificate preview upgrade: make the actual document readable before opening it */
.rjx-cert-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;align-items:start}
.rjx-cert-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(17,37,67,.04)}
.rjx-cert-thumb{height:520px;background:#f5f7fa;border-bottom:1px solid #e6eaf0;padding:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.rjx-cert-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;border-radius:7px;image-rendering:auto;cursor:zoom-in;transform:translateZ(0);backface-visibility:hidden}
.rjx-cert-info{padding:17px}
.rjx-cert-info h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#14243d;font-size:20px;margin:7px 0}
.rjx-cert-info p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:#718096}
.rjx-cert-view{margin-top:8px}

/* One-to-one + group lesson pages */
.rjx-teaching-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:13px 0 18px;display:grid;gap:7px}
.rjx-teaching-list li{position:relative;padding-left:18px;color:#526078;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45}
.rjx-teaching-list li:before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;color:#0b63f6;font-weight:900}
.rjx-group-banner{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e8ef;border-radius:18px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(17,37,67,.04)}
.rjx-group-banner h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:31px;color:#0b1730;margin:8px 0}
.rjx-group-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:15px}
.rjx-group-fact{border:1px solid #e5eaf1;background:#f9fbfd;border-radius:11px;padding:13px}
.rjx-group-fact strong{display:block;color:#14243d;font-size:13px}
.rjx-group-fact span{display:block;color:#748196;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.4}

@media(max-width:920px){
  .rjx-member-levels{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .rjx-help-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .rjx-cert-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .rjx-about-profile{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .rjx-group-facts{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .main-nav.open .nav-drop{display:block}
  .main-nav.open .nav-drop>a{display:block}
  .main-nav.open .nav-drop-menu{
    display:grid;position:static;min-width:0;border:0;border-left:2px solid #e3e8ef;
    border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;padding:0 0 6px 12px;margin:-4px 0 5px
  }
  .main-nav.open .nav-drop-menu button{padding:9px 8px;background:#fff}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .rjx-member-levels,.rjx-help-grid,.rjx-group-facts{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>


<style id="v15-toeic-photo-style">
.rjx-toeic-photo.real img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid rgba(7,23,47,.08);box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(7,23,47,.16)}
.rjx-photo-focus{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.rjx-photo-focus .rjx-check{margin:0}
.rjx-vocab-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.rjx-vocab-chips span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff4ea;border:1px solid #ffd6b5;color:#8b3c00;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem}
.rjx-question-block{margin-top:16px;padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(7,23,47,.08);border-radius:16px;background:#fff}
.rjx-question-block h5{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1rem;color:#0f2749}
.rjx-guided-grid{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:14px}
.rjx-guided-grid .rjx-resource{height:100%}
.rjx-model-answer{display:none;margin-top:10px;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff8f1;border:1px solid #ffd6b5;line-height:1.65}
.rjx-model-answer.show{display:block}
@media (max-width: 800px){.rjx-guided-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<style id="v16-photo-course-style">
.v16-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:14px}
.v16-task{padding:16px;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(7,23,47,.1)}
.v16-task h4,.v16-task h5{margin-top:0}
.v16-drop-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
.v16-label-bank,.v16-drop-zone{min-height:110px;border:2px dashed #c9d4e4;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;background:#f8fbff}
.v16-drag{display:inline-block;padding:8px 11px;margin:5px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff4ea;border:1px solid #ffbf86;cursor:grab;font-weight:700}
.v16-drop-zone.good{border-color:#67a96b;background:#f2fbf2}
.v16-build-bank{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:10px 0}
.v16-word{padding:8px 11px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #ccd7e6;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.v16-sentence{min-height:48px;border:1px solid #ccd7e6;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;background:#f7f9fc;margin-bottom:8px}
.v16-flips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(145px,1fr));gap:10px}
.v16-flip{min-height:86px;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:#0f2749;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.v16-flip.revealed{background:#fff4ea;color:#8b3c00;border:1px solid #ffcfaa}
.v16-compare{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.v16-compare>div{padding:14px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(7,23,47,.1)}
.v16-weak{background:#fff5f3}.v16-strong{background:#f2fbf2}
.v16-tip{padding:12px;border-left:4px solid #ff7a00;background:#fff8f1;border-radius:10px;margin-top:10px}
.v16-mini-feedback{display:none;margin-top:8px;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;background:#f2f7ff}
.v16-mini-feedback.show{display:block}
@media(max-width:800px){.v16-grid,.v16-drop-wrap,.v16-compare{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
<style id="rjx-v18-css">
.rjx-tool-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:18px}.rjx-tool-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.rjx-tool-card h3{margin:8px 0}.rjx-lab-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.45fr) minmax(280px,.7fr);gap:18px}.rjx-question-card{padding:16px;border:1px solid #dde6f1;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;margin-top:12px}.rjx-voice-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}.rjx-select{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #ccd7e5;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;max-width:100%}.rjx-dict-result{margin-top:18px}.rjx-dict-word{font-size:34px;font-weight:900}.rjx-phonetic{color:#0b63f6;font-weight:800}.rjx-syns{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.rjx-syns <style id="v20-nav-alignment-fix">
/* V20: alignment-only fix for the existing top navigation. */
@media (min-width:801px){
  .site-header{height:82px}
  .nav-wrap{min-height:82px;align-items:center}
  .main-nav{
    height:82px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-wrap:nowrap;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .main-nav > a,
  .main-nav > .nav-drop{
    height:82px;
    min-height:82px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    align-self:stretch;
    line-height:1;
  }
  .main-nav > a{padding:0}
  .main-nav > .nav-drop > a{
    height:82px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    padding:0;
    position:relative;
    line-height:1;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .main-nav a.active::after{bottom:17px}
  .nav-drop-menu{top:72px}
  .chev{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    line-height:1;
    margin-left:4px;
    transform:translateY(-1px);
  }
  .book-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap}
}
@media (min-width:801px) and (max-width:1180px){
  .nav-wrap{gap:14px}
  .brand{min-width:200px}
  .main-nav{gap:clamp(8px,1.1vw,16px);font-size:12.5px}
  .book-btn{padding:13px 16px;font-size:13px}
}
@media (min-width:801px) and (max-width:980px){
  .brand{min-width:175px;gap:10px}
  .brand-mark{font-size:46px}
  .brand-copy strong{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1.4px}
  .brand-copy span{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:2px}
  .main-nav{gap:7px;font-size:11.5px}
  .book-btn{padding:12px 11px;font-size:12px}
}
</style>


<style id="v21-kids-forensic-fix">
/* V21 forensic fixes: preserve the existing design, make every Kids control readable and stable. */
.rjx-kids-path,.rjx-kids-world,.rjx-kids-lesson-row,
.rjx-kid-option,.rjx-kid-chip,.rjx-kid-tabs button,.rjx-kid-scene button{
  color:#14213d;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor;
}
.rjx-kids-path,.rjx-kids-world,.rjx-kids-lesson-row{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
.rjx-kid-option{color:#14213d;background:#fff;line-height:1.35;text-align:center;word-break:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.rjx-kid-option:disabled{opacity:1;-webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor}
.rjx-kid-option.correct:disabled{color:#126632;-webkit-text-fill-color:#126632}
.rjx-kid-option.wrong:disabled{color:#9b232a;-webkit-text-fill-color:#9b232a}
.rjx-kid-chip{color:#14213d;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14213d}
.rjx-kid-chip:disabled{opacity:.5;color:#14213d;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14213d}
.rjx-kid-answer{color:#14213d;background:#fff;min-height:58px}
.rjx-kid-scene button{color:#14213d;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14213d}
.rjx-kids-lesson-row strong,.rjx-kids-lesson-row small,.rjx-kids-world h3,.rjx-kids-world p,.rjx-kids-path h3,.rjx-kids-path p{opacity:1}
.rjx-kids-world .count{color:#0b63f6}
.rjx-kid-feedback{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
.rjx-kid-text-task{max-width:720px;margin:14px auto}
.rjx-kid-audio-word{font-size:14px;color:#5d6f86;text-align:center;margin-top:7px}
@media (min-width:801px){
  .main-nav > .kids-nav-drop{height:82px;min-height:82px;display:flex;align-items:center;align-self:stretch;line-height:1}
  .main-nav > .kids-nav-drop > a{height:82px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap}
}
</style>

<style id="v21-nav-responsive-forensic-fix">
/* Keep the existing desktop header design, but prevent overflow as the viewport narrows. */
@media (min-width:1001px) and (max-width:1350px){
  .nav-wrap{width:min(1320px,96vw);gap:10px}
  .brand{min-width:170px;gap:9px}
  .brand-mark{font-size:44px}
  .brand-copy strong{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
  .brand-copy span{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1.7px}
  .main-nav{gap:8px;font-size:11.5px}
  .book-btn{padding:12px 10px;font-size:12px}
}
@media (min-width:801px) and (max-width:1000px){
  .site-header{height:82px}
  .main-nav,.book-btn{display:none!important}
  .mobile-toggle{display:block!important}
  .main-nav.open{
    display:flex!important;position:absolute;top:82px;left:0;right:0;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;
    background:#fff;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:10px 24px 22px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 30px rgba(20,35,60,.09);white-space:normal
  }
  .main-nav.open>a,.main-nav.open>.nav-drop{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;display:block!important}
  .main-nav.open>.nav-drop>a{height:auto!important;display:block!important;padding:13px 0!important}
  .main-nav.open a{padding:13px 0!important}
  .main-nav.open .nav-drop-menu{
    display:grid;position:static;min-width:0;border:0;border-left:2px solid #e3e8ef;
    border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;padding:0 0 6px 12px;margin:-4px 0 5px
  }
  .main-nav.open .nav-drop-menu button{padding:9px 8px;background:#fff}
  .main-nav a.active::after{bottom:5px;width:34px;right:auto}
}
</style>

<style id="v26-readability-repair">
/* V26 readability repair: keep all V25 features, make the smart front door much easier to see and use. */
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
#v25LearningHome,#v25Skills,#v25Today,#v25Method,#v25Universe,.v25-explorer{font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
.v25-wrap,.v25-section{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 32px))}
.v25-command{padding:38px 0 28px}
.v25-command-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}
.v25-panel{padding:28px;border-color:#d7e1ee;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(25,48,84,.06)}
.v25-eyebrow{font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1.7px}
.v25-panel h2{font-size:34px;line-height:1.18;margin:8px 0 10px}
.v25-panel h3{font-size:24px;line-height:1.25}
.v25-panel p,.v25-section-head p,.v25-skill p,.v25-today-card p,.v25-step p,.v25-result p,.v25-character small,.v25-home-note,.v25-word-card p{font-size:15.5px!important;line-height:1.55;color:#46566b}
.v25-continue{grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:16px;padding:18px;margin-top:18px;background:#f5f8fd}
.v25-continue .ico{font-size:31px}.v25-continue strong{font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;color:#10243f}
#v25ContinueMeta{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.45!important;color:#526278!important}
.v25-mini-progress{height:9px;margin-top:10px}
.v25-personal-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:18px}
.v25-personal-row label{font-size:14px;line-height:1.35;color:#24364e}
.v25-personal-row select{font-size:16px;min-height:48px;padding:11px 12px}
.v25-time-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.v25-time{min-height:92px;padding:17px;font-size:16px}.v25-time strong{font-size:20px}.v25-time small{font-size:14px;line-height:1.35}
.v25-member-path{font-size:15px;line-height:1.55;padding:16px}
.v25-section{padding:46px 0;scroll-margin-top:96px}
.v25-section-head{align-items:center;margin-bottom:22px}
.v25-section-head h2{font-size:34px;line-height:1.18;margin:5px 0 8px}
.v25-skill-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.v25-skill{min-height:0;padding:22px}.v25-skill .ico{font-size:32px}.v25-skill h3{font-size:20px;line-height:1.3}
.v25-explorer{padding:46px 0;background:#102745}.v25-explorer .v25-section-head p{color:#e5edf8!important}.v25-explorer .v25-eyebrow{color:#9fc5ff}
.v25-searchbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}.v25-searchbar input{flex:2 1 320px}.v25-searchbar select{flex:1 1 165px}
.v25-searchbar input,.v25-searchbar select{font-size:16px;min-height:48px;padding:11px 13px}
.v25-results{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.v25-result{min-height:0;padding:18px}.v25-result .meta{font-size:12px}.v25-result h4{font-size:18px;line-height:1.3}
.v25-today-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.v25-today-card{min-height:0;padding:22px}.v25-today-card .tag{font-size:11px}.v25-today-card h3{font-size:20px;line-height:1.3}
.v25-journey{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:12px}.v25-step{padding:19px}.v25-step::after{display:none}.v25-step b{font-size:13px}.v25-step h3{font-size:20px}
.v25-cast-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:12px}.v25-character{padding:18px}.v25-avatar{width:58px;height:58px;font-size:28px}.v25-character h4{font-size:18px}
.v25-case-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:14px}.v25-case{padding:20px}.v25-clue{font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;padding:12px}
.v25-brain-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:12px}.v25-word-card{padding:17px}.v25-word-card h4{font-size:18px}
.v25-detective-card{padding:26px}.v25-detective-card p{font-size:16px!important;color:#e2eaf5!important}
#v25LearningHome button,#v25Skills button,#v25Today button,#v25Method button,#v25Universe button,.v25-explorer button,.v25-explorer input,.v25-explorer select{min-height:46px}
.v25-result,.v25-skill,.v25-today-card,.v25-time{white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

@media(max-width:900px){
 .v25-wrap,.v25-section{width:min(100% - 28px,900px)}
 .v25-time-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
 .v25-personal-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .v25-skill-grid,.v25-today-grid,.v25-results{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .v25-panel h2,.v25-section-head h2{font-size:30px}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
 .v25-wrap,.v25-section{width:calc(100% - 22px)}
 .v25-command{padding:22px 0 16px}.v25-panel{padding:18px;border-radius:15px}
 .v25-panel h2,.v25-section-head h2{font-size:27px}
 .v25-panel h3{font-size:21px}
 .v25-continue{grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr);padding:15px;gap:11px}
 .v25-continue .v25-launch{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%;min-height:48px}
 .v25-time-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.v25-time{min-height:82px;padding:14px}
 .v25-section{padding:32px 0}.v25-section-head{display:block;margin-bottom:16px}.v25-section-head>button{margin-top:12px;width:100%}
 .v25-searchbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}.v25-searchbar input,.v25-searchbar select{width:100%}
 .v25-today-card,.v25-skill,.v25-result,.v25-case,.v25-step,.v25-character{padding:17px}
}
@media(max-width:410px){
 .v25-time-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .v25-panel h2,.v25-section-head h2{font-size:25px}
}
</style>

<style id="v27-overhaul-style">
/* ================= V27 UX OVERHAUL ================= */
.v27-slim-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.v27-slim-list .rjx-row{min-height:86px;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:14px;align-items:center}
.v27-slim-list .rjx-row>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:0}
.v27-slim-list .rjx-row strong{font-size:18px;line-height:1.25;color:#10213c}
.v27-slim-list .rjx-row small{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:#708097}
.v27-slim-list .rjx-tag{align-self:flex-start;margin-bottom:1px}
.v27-slim-list .rjx-chip{white-space:nowrap;margin-left:18px}
.v27-premium-hero{min-height:445px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f8fbff 0%,#ffffff 48%,#eef5ff 100%)!important;border-bottom:1px solid #dfe9f6}
.v27-premium-hero::before{display:none!important}
.v27-premium-hero::after{height:70px!important;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#f8fafc 0%,rgba(248,250,252,0) 100%)!important}
.v27-premium-hero .hero-inner{min-height:445px!important;align-items:center!important}
.v27-premium-hero .hero-copy{width:min(820px,74%)!important;padding:56px 0 74px!important}
.v27-premium-hero h1{font-size:58px!important;line-height:1.02!important;letter-spacing:-2.3px!important;max-width:760px}
.v27-premium-hero p{max-width:720px!important;font-size:20px!important;margin:21px 0 25px!important}
.v27-hero-points{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin-top:21px}
.v27-hero-points span{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d8e4f3;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 12px;color:#435571;font-weight:750;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(19,57,110,.05)}
.v27-dict .rjx-dict-search{margin-top:14px}
.v27-word-pill{border:1px solid #d7e2f0;background:#f7faff;color:#1d3e6c;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 11px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.v27-word-pill:hover{background:#eaf2ff;border-color:#b9d0ef}
.v27-dict-source{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;background:#eef5ff;color:#2b5fa8;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 8px;margin-left:7px}
.v27-dict-loading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:15px;border:1px solid #dce7f4;background:#f9fbfe;border-radius:12px}
.v27-dict-loading span{color:#63738a}
@media(max-width:1000px){.v27-premium-hero .hero-copy{width:100%!important}.v27-premium-hero h1{font-size:48px!important}}
@media(max-width:700px){.v27-premium-hero{min-height:auto!important}.v27-premium-hero .hero-inner{min-height:auto!important}.v27-premium-hero .hero-copy{padding:38px 0 52px!important}.v27-premium-hero h1{font-size:39px!important;letter-spacing:-1.3px!important}.v27-premium-hero p{font-size:17px!important}.v27-slim-list .rjx-row{align-items:flex-start!important;flex-direction:column!important}.v27-slim-list .rjx-chip{margin-left:0;margin-top:8px}.v27-hero-points{gap:7px}.v27-hero-points span{font-size:11px}}
/* ================= END V27 UX OVERHAUL ================= */

</style>

<main id="rjHomeMain">

    <div class="hero-inner">
      <div class="hero-copy">
        <div class="kicker">BRITISH ENGLISH <span>— FOR REAL LIFE</span></div>
        <h1>Learn English with<br><em>Confidence</em></h1>
        <div class="hero-welcome" aria-label="RJ Language Academy introduction">
          <h2>Learn English Your Way</h2>
          <p>Welcome to RJ Language Academy — a complete English learning platform designed to help you improve from A1 beginner to C2 advanced.</p>
          <p>Start with free lessons and interactive practice, including grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, pronunciation, quizzes, games and IELTS &amp; TOEIC preparation.</p>
          <p>Want to go further? Join RJ Silver, Gold or Platinum to unlock larger courses, premium practice, personalised learning, progress tracking, revision tools, challenges and much more.</p>
          <p>You can also prepare for exams, improve your British pronunciation, build your everyday English, practise with interactive activities, and book one-to-one or small group lessons with a real teacher.</p>
          <p>Learn at your own pace. Practise what you need. See your English improve.</p>
          <p>Start exploring the academy today.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-actions">
          <a class="cta primary" href="#practice">Start Free Practice <span>→</span></a>
          <a class="cta secondary" href="#members">Explore the Academy</a>
        </div>
      </div>
